#Create transcript db for importing the kallisto output. Maps ENSMBL transcript IDs to Gene IDs
```{r}
library("GenomicFeatures")

createTxDB <- function(gtf, output_file){
  txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf)
  k <- keys(txdb, keytype = "TXNAME")  
  tx2gene <- select(txdb, keys = k,
                  columns = c("GENEID"),
                  keytype = "TXNAME")
  # Remove version numbers from transcript IDs
  tx2gene[,1] <- sub("\\..*$", "", tx2gene[,1])
  write.table(tx2gene,
            file = output_file,
             quote = FALSE,
             sep = "\t",
             row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = FALSE)
  return(tx2gene)
  }

output_txdb = "/data_pool/raw_data/reference_genomes/mouse/ensembl/tx2gene.tsv"
if (!file.exists(output_txdb)) {
  tx2gene = createTxDB(gtf = "/data_pool/raw_data/reference_genomes/mouse/ensembl/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.115.gtf",
           output_file = output_txdb)
}

tx2gene <- read_tsv(output_txdb)
```

#Import counts from kallisto mapping.
```{r}
library(tximport)
# Read your table

import_kallisto <- function(sample_path){
  samples <- read.table(sample_path, header = TRUE, sep = ",")
  
  # Build named vector of kallisto abundance files
  files <- setNames(samples$path, samples$sample)
  
  # Import kallisto results
  txi <- tximport(
      files,
      type = "kallisto",
      tx2gene = tx2gene,
      countsFromAbundance = "no",
      ignoreTxVersion = TRUE
  )
  
  # Build DESeq2 metadata
  metadata <- samples[, c("condition", "replicate")]
  rownames(metadata) <- samples$sample
  
  # Build DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
      txi,
      colData = metadata,
      design = ~ condition
  )
  return(dds)
}

#Run DeSeq2
process_deseq<-function(d){
  # Extract results
  res <- results(d)
  
  # Order by adjusted p-value
  res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
  res$symbol <- mapIds(
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = rownames(res),
      column = "SYMBOL",
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      multiVals = "first"
  )
  return(res) 
}

dds <- import_kallisto(sample_path = "/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/samples.txt")
# Run DESeq2 differential expression
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- process_deseq(dds)

test=as.data.frame(res)
# Save full results
```

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 15}
#BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")
library(EnhancedVolcano)

make_enhanced_volcano <- function(res,output_path){

  # Make gene names rownames
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df <-  res_df %>% filter(!is.na(symbol))
  
  # Genes to label
  label_genes <- c("Csta3","Trem2", "Gpnmb", "Cstb", "Spp1", "Lgals3", "Apoe")

  p<-EnhancedVolcano(
    res_df,
    lab = res_df$symbol,
    x = "log2FoldChange",
    y = "padj",
    ylim = c(0,-log10(10e-5)),
    xlim = c(-12,12),
    selectLab = label_genes,     # only label these genes【2】
    labCol = "black",            # label color
    pCutoff = 0.05,
    FCcutoff = 1,
    pointSize= 0.5,
    labSize=6.0,
    colConnectors = "black",
    gridlines.major = FALSE,   # 【1】
    gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    col=c('gray', 'gray', 'gray', 'red3'),
    colAlpha = 1, 
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.75
  ) #+ scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2))

  
  if (!missing(output_path)){
    ggsave(output_path, p, width = 10, height = 15, dpi = 300)}
  return(p)
  
}

make_enhanced_volcano(res,
                  output_path="/projects/margeta/phagocytosis/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/251204_phag_v_no_phag_volcano.png")
```

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=18}
top_genes_heatmap <- function(res, dds, n=25){

  # 1. Select top n up and n down
  res_ordered <- res[order(res$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  #res_ordered <- res[order(res$padj, decreasing = FALSE), ] #alternatively sort on padj
  top_up <- head(res_ordered, n)
  top_down <- tail(res_ordered, n)
  top_genes <- c(rownames(top_up), rownames(top_down))
  #top_genes <- rownames(head(res_ordered,n*2)) #alternatively take the top genes regardless of up or down

  # 2. VST transform
  vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds))[top_genes, ]
  rownames(vst_mat) <- mapIds(
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = rownames(vst_mat),
      column = "SYMBOL",
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      multiVals = "first"
  )
  # 3. Build row labels (label only selected genes)
  row_labels <- ifelse(rownames(vst_mat) %in% genes,
                       rownames(vst_mat),
                       "")
  
  dds_sub <- assay(dds[top_genes, ])

  rownames(dds_sub) <- mapIds(
      org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = rownames(dds_sub),
      column = "SYMBOL",
      keytype = "ENSEMBL",
      multiVals = "first"
  )
  dds_sub <- log2(dds_sub + 1)
  
  # scale by row so each gene shows relative expression
  dds_sub <- t(scale(t(dds_sub)))
  
  # 4. pheatmap
  p<-pheatmap(
    dds_sub,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize = 10,
    fontsize_row = 12,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    border_color = NA,
    ##cellwidth = 15,
    #cellheight = 10
  )
  return(p)
}

# dds: your DESeqDataSet
# res: DESeq2 results
# genes: vector of genes you want labeled
# 0. Remove entries with NA log2FoldChange, no gene symbol or gene symbols that begin with Gm 
res_filt <- res[!(is.na(res$log2FoldChange)), ]
p <- top_genes_heatmap(res_filt,dds,25)
res_filt <- res[!(is.na(res$log2FoldChange))&!(is.na(res$symbol)), ]
p <- top_genes_heatmap(res_filt,dds,25)
res_filt <- res[!(is.na(res$log2FoldChange))&!(is.na(res$symbol))&!grepl("^Gm", res$symbol), ]
p <- top_genes_heatmap(res_filt,dds,25)
```

```{r}
  multiVals = "first"
)

rowData(dds)$symbol <- symbols

plot_pca <- function(dds){
  # dds: your DESeqDataSet
  # "condition" is an example column in colData(dds); replace with yours
  
  # 1. VST transform
  vsd <- vst(dds)
  
  # 2. Extract PCA data (built-in helper)
  pca_data <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)
  
  # Percent variance
  percent_var <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))
  
  # 3. Pretty PCA with point labels
  ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, label = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3.5, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    #geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5) +
    expand_limits(
      x = c(min(pca_data$PC1) - 5, max(pca_data$PC1) + 5),
      y = c(min(pca_data$PC2) - 5, max(pca_data$PC2) + 5)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percent_var[1], "% variance")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percent_var[2], "% variance"))
}
plot_pca(dds)
dds_filt <- dds[!is.na(rowData(dds)$symbol) &!grepl("^Gm", rowData(dds)$symbol),
]
plot_pca(dds_filt)
```

```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)

make_volcano_plot <- function(){
  
}
# Assume 'res' is your DESeq2 results object:
# res <- results(dds)

# Convert to data frame
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

# Add a column to indicate significance
res_df$significant <- with(
  res_df,
  ifelse(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, "Significant", "Not Significant")
)


# Genes to label
label_genes <- c("Trem2", "Gpmnb", "Cstb", "Spp1", "Lgals3", "Apoe")

# Add label column
res_df$label <- ifelse(res_df$symbol %in% label_genes, res_df$symbol, NA)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                   y = -log10(padj),
                   color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    color = "black",  
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()  # Removes all gridlines
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value"
  )
```

```{r}


# ---- 1. Read Kallisto abundance file ----
abundance <- read_tsv("/output/kallisto_results/mouse_ensbl/B6Cont1NonPhag/abundance.tsv")

# ---- 2. Read Ensembl GTF annotation ----
gtf <- read_tsv("/data/raw_data/reference_genomes/mouse/ensembl/Mus_musculus.GRCm39.115.gtf",
                comment = "#",
                col_names = FALSE)

# GTF columns (Ensembl standard):
# 1 seqname, 2 source, 3 feature, 4 start, 5 end, 6 score,
# 7 strand, 8 frame, 9 attribute

# ---- 3. Extract transcript IDs for rRNA ----
# Filter rows with rRNA biotype
rRNA_gtf <- gtf %>%
  filter(str_detect(X9, 'gene_biotype "rRNA"') | 
         str_detect(X9, 'transcript_biotype "rRNA"'))

# Extract transcript_id values
rRNA_ids <- str_match(rRNA_gtf$X9, 'transcript_id "([^"]+)"')[,2] 

# ---- 4. Filter Kallisto output for rRNA transcripts ----
rRNA_abundance <- abundance %>%
  filter(target_id_trimmed %in% rRNA_ids)

# ---- 5. Calculate total rRNA reads and total reads ----
total_rRNA_reads <- sum(rRNA_abundance$est_counts)
total_reads <- sum(abundance$est_counts)

# ---- 6. Calculate percentage ----
percent_rRNA <- (total_rRNA_reads / total_reads) * 100

# ---- 7. Output result ----
cat("Percent ribosomal reads:", round(percent_rRNA, 2), "%\n")
```
